newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CVRD upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CVRD upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Nomura said it upgraded Brazilian state mining conglomerate Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) to buy from neutral.
-- It also said it was increasing its 1996 earnings per ADR estimate on CVRD to $1.10 from $0.52, and its 1996 EBITDA per ADR estimate to $2.23 from $1.77.
-- Analyst Steven Assis said in a report that the new estimates were based on a 14 percent increase in domestic iron ore prices in the 1996 second half.
-- He also said the elimination of the so-called ICMS tax on exports, which took effect on September 16, "should save the company $120 million p.a."
-- The report said Nomura's target price for CVRD stock is $28, a 35 percent increase over the next 12-18 months.
-- CVRD is expected to be privatized in the first quarter of 1997.
-- CVRD preferred shares traded at 20.80 reais, up 0.48 percent, at 1300 local time/1600 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
